I had the same problem.  Little ugly hack to get it to work temporarily.  In Windows, install bsdtar as described by http://www.worthinstalling.com/2006/06/command-line-compression-for-windows.html.  Then in R copy and paste this amended runGist code https://gist.github.com/4059340 to override shiny's runGist.  Hopefully, this will work.  I have put in a request https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/35 with the developers to potentially make this a little easier.
 
 
Kent

I checked in a fix. See the issue page for the snippet you need to put in .Rprofile.

Until we cut a new build of Shiny, you'll need to install it directly from GitHub if you want this fix:

library(devtools)
install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')
